messages:
lia: Heads-up — canary for dedicated pool v2026.2 just started flagging perf. P99 latency up ~35% on 2 nodes, throughput steady but SLA risk. Blocking rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy v2026.2 -> dedicated-gpu-pool-3 failed health checks at 1769823620. Marking as failed.

alex: I'm on it. Running quick bisect across commits merged today (PR #3456, #3459, #3462). Will try to repro locally.

maria: initial perf-summary from canary:
```
model: re19-large
seq: avg 512
p50/p95/p99 baseline: 22ms / 108ms / 180ms
canary: 25ms / 150ms / 240ms
kv_cache_miss_rate: baseline 3% -> canary 19%
batch_size_dist changed: more small batches (1-2) observed
```

zach: interesting — kernel selection log shows fallback to 'int8-gemm' kernels for many layers on these host GPUs after the new heuristic. That path has worse perf when KV cache miss + long prefix. Dumped selector trace:
```
[selector] model=re19-large seq=512 layer=12 chosen=int8-gemm reason=latency_estimate
[selector] estimated_throughput_down 30%
```

alex: @zach can you post the commit that introduced the selector change? I think it's PR #3459 (adaptive-kernel-priority).

zach: yes PR #3459 bumped kernel priority to prefer quantized kernels when memory headroom is low. But it didn't account for high KV cache churn which increases memory ops.

maria: profiler flamegraph (summary): CPU time shifted into 'kv_cache::fetch' + 'int8_transform' hot paths. KV miss amplification looks like the culprit.

samir: Repro locally with the canary config and synthetic replay? If we can recreate we can bisect to the exact commit.

alex: repro steps I used:
```
git checkout canary-commit
./scripts/run_replay --trace-prefixes=long --batch-policy=auto --load-kv
# observe p99 with `./tools/perf_summary --unit=ms`
```

lia: Customers on Dedicated could see degraded latency under certain prefix distributions. Immediate mitigation options?

maria: +1 to pinning kernel-selection to previous heuristic for Dedicated only. Also turn off auto-quant prefer during rollout.

oncall-sre: @oncall-sre I'm adding incident tag. Need rollback if workaround doesn't hold.

alex: I ran a binary revert to PR #3459 on canary, re-ran replay: p99 back to 190ms -> within 10% of baseline. KV miss rate back to ~4%.

deploy-bot: Canary redeploy with revert applied succeeded health checks at 1769823750.

lia: OK let's hold the rollout until we have a fix that accounts for KV miss/seq distribution. Action items:
- alex: open hotfix PR to guard kernel priority by KV miss estimate (due EOD)
- maria: run expanded perf suite across seq distributions and update canary configs
- zach: add a selector test that simulates high KV churn
- samir: notify three affected customers and offer dedicated monitoring

samir: pinging #sales to prepare customer comms draft. @marketing optional.

lia: Thanks team. Filing a postmortem once root cause fully verified. Blocking flag remains set.

maria: quick note: CI perf job also showed a smaller regression on main branch; I'll attach artifact to the PR.

alex: I'll link the revert and perf artifacts in the PR. Good job catching this fast :thumbsup:
